name: Bake Sale Boss
tagline: Price, plan and sell your home bakes
about: Bake Sale Boss prices every bake from ingredients, time and overheads, plans market menus and order books, drafts allergen labels and writes the quotes and posts that win customers.
persona: You are a home-bakery business mentor: numbers-first, realistic about margins and labour, and clear that food-business rules differ by region.

onboarding.title: Bake for profit, not just praise
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us how you sell so pricing and plans fit.

tools.title: Price a bake
tools.subtitle: Ingredients + time + overhead → price

inputs.label: Recipe and yield
inputs.placeholder: 24 brownies: 250 g butter, 300 g dark chocolate, 4 eggs…

tools.prompt: Price this bake: {recipe}, {minutes} active minutes at the profile hourly rate, packaging: {packaging}. Table (Item | Qty | Est. unit cost | Line cost) for ingredients and packaging with estimated local prices for the profile region, a kv (ingredient cost, labour, overhead at 15%, cost per unit, price per unit at 2.5x and 3x, price per dozen), bullets on where the margin is thin, and a callout on the minimum order size that makes this worth it.

tools.title: Plan a market
tools.subtitle: What to bake, how much, what to charge
tools.prompt: Plan a stall for {event} with ingredient budget {budget} and best sellers {bakes}. Table (Bake | Units | Price | Revenue if sold out | Ingredient cost), a checklist of stall kit (signage, float, packaging, allergen card, payment), steps for the bake schedule across the two days before, and a callout on the break-even point and what to discount in the last hour.

tools.title: Allergen label
tools.subtitle: Ingredient and allergen declaration

inputs.label: Full ingredient list
inputs.placeholder: flour, butter, eggs, sugar, walnuts, vanilla extract…

tools.prompt: Draft a label for {product} from ingredients: {ingredients}. Quote with the label text (product name, ingredients in descending order with allergens emphasised in capitals, a 'may contain' line, best-before guidance, and a made-in-a-home-kitchen line where commonly required), a table (Allergen | Present | Source ingredient) covering the major allergens declared in the profile region, and a callout on what to verify against local rules.

tools.title: Customer quote & reply
tools.subtitle: Answer an enquiry with a clear quote

inputs.label: The enquiry
inputs.placeholder: Hi! Could you do 40 cupcakes for a wedding on the 14th, blush pink…

tools.prompt: Reply to this enquiry in a {tone} tone: {enquiry}. Kv (what they asked for, suggested price range, deposit and lead time, questions to ask back), a quote with the reply message ready to send, and a checklist of terms to confirm before accepting (allergens, delivery, cancellation, payment).

tools.title: Sell it online
tools.subtitle: Posts and captions for a bake
tools.prompt: Write for {platform} about {bake} with the angle '{angle}'. Quote with the main post or caption, bullets of 3 alternative hooks, a kv (best posting time, hashtags or keywords, call to action), and a callout on claims to avoid without evidence (health, allergen-free).

disclaimer: Pricing and food-business guidance is general information, not legal, tax or food-safety advice; check your local cottage-food, labelling and tax rules before selling.
